author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
When you watch a classic movie re-released in 70mm large-format film, this is the room where that print was likely made. Adam visits the optical recording lab at Fotokem, where technicians turn one format of film into another--either a blow up or a reduction--by literally pointing a film projector into a film camera. This conversion of analog formats is done frame by frame in a painstaking process requiring exacting precision. 

How IMAX 70MM Film is Developed: https://youtu.be/WejZgrMZSL8
